style: Premium semi-realistic editorial illustration for a Chinese night-market bargaining lesson: warm red canopy, amber lanterns, painterly shadows and clean confident contours. Keep a consistent orange-and-wood palette across all views. Background only, with no characters, people, hands, animals, marks on the tag, readable signs, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks. Keep the small blank price tag and its mandarin crate clear of the lower quarter reserved for HSK AI character overlays.

assets.name: market-stall
assets.prompt: Customer-side establishing view of one Chinese night-market fruit stall at evening. A wooden crate of mandarins and one small blank cream price tag are the clear focal subject in the middle of the frame; warm red canopy and amber hanging lanterns make the night market recognizable, neighboring stalls softly blurred. Leave clean space in the top quarter and lower quarter for the lesson overlays. No readable writing or prices.

assets.name: market-evaluation
assets.prompt: Tighter customer-eye view of the same stall, same exact wooden crate of mandarins and small blank cream tag. Show the fruit and tag together, centered and clearly recognizable, with the tag modest in size at center-right and the lower quarter quiet for small character overlays. Same warm red-and-amber market palette and softly blurred market background.

assets.name: market-request
assets.prompt: Slightly wider customer-counter view of the same stall, identical crate of mandarins and unchanged small blank cream tag together in the upper-middle. Keep an uncluttered lower quarter for two small HSK AI character overlays as buyer and seller. Suggest an inviting place to make a polite request through the open counter and warm lights; do not alter the product or imply a price change.
